title: feat(cli): os secret orphans also reports sys_secret handles more than one holder names, or a column other than their own holds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DECWEobVDFstMHroz5Kem8z)_

Fixes #27721

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`os secret orphans` 的报告模式在原有孤儿报告之外,新增一节「被命名的 handle」:列出被多于一个持有记录命名的 `sys_secret` handle(shared),以及持有它的列不是其 `(namespace, key)` 所指列的 handle(misplaced),带计数与每个持有者的对象/字段/记录;谓词更新造成的同列共享单独列出、不作判定。
- **为什么改**:非系统写入现在只能保留本记录自己的引用,但此前已存的值没有被重新检查;原报告只回答「谁都不引用的行」,回答不了「一个 handle 被几处引用、是否在自己的列里」。
- **风险与回滚**:只读、只报告;不进入 `--delete` 的删除计划,不修复任何东西,不打印任何密文或明文。`--json` 多出一个顶层键 `holders`(增量)。回滚即整 PR revert。
- **先看**:`packages/cli/src/utils/sys-secret-holder-report.ts`(分类规则与谓词更新的区分)、`packages/cli/src/utils/secret-reference-union.ts`(每个引用新增的结构化持有坐标)、`packages/cli/src/commands/secret/orphans.ts`(只在报告模式输出)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/utils/sys-secret-holder-report.test.ts`,预期 14 个用例全绿,其中谓词更新那条由真实引擎写出共享 handle。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`secret-reference-union.ts`** — every `SecretReference` now carries `column`: the holding object, field and record, and the `(namespace, key)` its producer records on a handle it mints for that column (`null` for the datasource binder, which records the pair its caller passes). Collected at the same read; the settings read now also selects `id` to name the record. The printable `holder` string is unchanged, and the module still contains no classification.
- **`sys-secret-holder-report.ts`** (new, pure) — a report-only pass over the `sys_secret` snapshots and the union:
  - `shared`: a handle more than one holder record names;
  - `misplaced`: a handle at least one holder of which is not the column its `(namespace, key)` names;
  - `sharedInOwnColumn`, listed apart: every holder is an `object-field` row of the handle's own minting column. That is the shape a predicate update writes; stored rows cannot tell it from a reference copied between rows of the same column, so it is listed, not judged. A share across settings rows never gets this exemption: settings seals one handle per row write.
  - Datasource holders are not judged for placement (counted, with a note). An incomplete union is reported on what was enumerated and names the missing family.
- **`os secret orphans`** — report mode prints the section and `--json` carries it as a new top-level `holders` key beside `plan`. `--delete` is untouched; the section never feeds the deletion plan. No new flag.
- **Docs** — the `os secret orphans` section of `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` describes the section. Changeset: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

On the additive `--json` key: no shipped consumer parses the `os secret orphans --json` document. In this repository it is read only by tests (`orphans.driver-contract.test.ts`, `data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts`, both via `toMatchObject` on `mode` and `plan`), and the docs call it "the same report, machine-readable" without stating a closed shape.

## Why

The orphan report answers which `sys_secret` rows nothing names. It did not answer whether a handle something does name is named by more than one holder, or held by a column other than the one its pair names, which is the question the engine's release asks before it removes a handle. Values stored before writes were limited to their own record's reference were never re-examined. Whether a repair path follows is a later decision; this PR builds none.

## Tests

- `sys-secret-holder-report.test.ts` (new, 14 cases): fixtures minted by the real producers (real `ObjectQL` write path including a real predicate update, real `LocalCryptoProvider`, real datasource binder), read back by the real union collector. Pins: a handle two settings rows name is `shared` with both holders' coordinates; a handle copied onto another column is `shared` and `misplaced`, naming which holder is out of place; a handle whose only holder is out of place is `misplaced`; the share the engine's predicate update wrote is in `sharedInOwnColumn` and in neither other class; a settings share is not exempted; datasource placement is not judged; counts per class; no plaintext and no cipher material anywhere in the serialized report (with an anti-vacuity check), and the store is unchanged; an incomplete union names its missing family.
- `secret-reference-union.test.ts`: each family's reference carries its `column` coordinates.
- `orphans.driver-contract.test.ts` (real SQLite, the command's own boot): the `--json` report lists a handle two seeded settings rows name under `holders.shared`, and the command's whole stdout carries none of the seeded cipher material. The command is run once and memoized across the two end-to-end cases.
- Ablations (each restored, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`):
  - own-column predicate forced `false` → 3 red (the predicate-update pin, the settings-not-exempt pin, counts);
  - placement forced `in_place` → 7 red (both misplaced pins, the cross-column share, the control, counts, the incomplete-union pin, the settings-not-exempt pin);
  - single-holder skip forced for every handle → 6 red (both shared pins, the predicate-update pin, counts, the incomplete-union pin, the settings-not-exempt pin);
  - `holders` dropped from the command's `--json` → the command-level pin red.

## Acceptance notes

- `sys-secret-orphan-sweep.test.ts` changes one fixture literal only (the new required `column` member); no assertion moved.
- A reference that names a handle with no `sys_secret` row is not listed: the card asks about `sys_secret` handles, and a dangling reference is a different question.

## Verification

All readings on head `2569bd1ae2` (this branch with `main` at `6d8372a8cd` merged in), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` — `93 derived, 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (exit 0). Every derived family exited 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` — exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck: OK`, debt unchanged at 3 files / 28 errors / 6 pinned signatures).
- Touched suites, `vitest run --project integration`: `sys-secret-holder-report`, `secret-reference-union`, `sys-secret-orphan-sweep`, `orphans.guards`, `orphans.driver-contract`, `orphans.journal-mode`, `data-commands.absent-database` — Test Files 7 passed, Tests 136 passed.
- The whole `unit` project of `@objectstack/cli` ran once before the merge (head `48a9b65dd2`): 349 of 351 files passed, 5055 tests passed. The two files that failed (`published-subpath-console.pin`, `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`) refused because `packages/cli` itself was not built yet; after the full build they pass on the final head (2 files, 29 tests).
- ESLint with the repo config and `--no-inline-config` over the seven touched TypeScript files — exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- Dogfood battery: n/a — no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
